1) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a compound of formula I that is specifically 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic, or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

3) (Currently amended) A composition for topical use comprising: a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the active ingredient is formulated for use in treating skin conditions.

4) (Currently amended) A composition according to one or more of Claims 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

6) (Currently amended) A composition according to claim 6, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient 5-ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight, for topical application.

7) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition effective for treating skin conditions.

8) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of various skin diseases associated with defective keratinization and inflammation, particularly acne and related conditions. 

9) (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or promoting hair follicle development.

10) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, specifically targeting conditions prone to aging.

11) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 as a skin lightening and/or improvement agent.

12) (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or improvement.

13) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin, or large-pored skin.

14) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced aging processes of the human skin or human hair, particularly targeting conditions such as dry skin, wrinkle formation, and pigment defects.
